text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Israeli sources: U.S. warns Syria against escalating tensions in the north.
- Treasury capital markets report to be released today.
- U.S. cautions Syria, Israel to act with restraint.
- Bezeq to allow Internet access for non-subscribers. Communications minister gave go-ahead for project dubbed 135 service. No date for launching yet.
- Zisser, Wertheimer agree to Africa Israel's spin-off.
- The Dankner Group intends to increase stake in Hapoalim Investments with aim of becoming a controlling shareholder.
- Syrian commando forces positioned north of Mt Hermon on Golan Heights. U.S. ambassador delivers harsh message to Israel from Syria: return to negotiations or everything is open.
- Israel tensely follows Syrian troop movements.
- Treasury report on market reform to propose benefits for long-term savings.
